source.note: 1995 Studio Baseball. The 200-card flagship checklist is one collector-facing VCS Base ProductSet. TCDB lists two pack insert sets: 50-card Gold and 25-card Platinum. No rookie cards or error/variation records are currently recognized for the flagship set.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: VCS-normalized pack: 4 cards per pack, 36 packs per box. The physical product was documented as five cards per pack; VCS uses the standing four-card pack rule while preserving verified per-pack insert frequencies.
decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: Base #1-200 remains one VCS Base ProductSet with equal availability for completion and prestige tracking.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: TCDB currently flags zero true rookie cards in this set, so no Player values receive an RC suffix.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains only the clean card subject name. Error/variation and odds text are not stored in Player.
decisions.oddsPlacement: Verified pack odds live only on ProductSets. Gold is one per pack and Platinum is 1:10 packs. No card Variant contains set-wide odds.
decisions.insertModeling: Gold and Platinum are collector-facing insert checklists rather than full 200-card base parallels: Gold contains 50 cards numbered 1-50 and Platinum contains 25 cards numbered 1-25.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until images and pricing are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete flagship checklist #1-200. No TCDB-recognized true RCs and no listed error/variation records.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: 50-card Gold insert checklist, numbered 1-50 and inserted one per pack.

productSets.name: Platinum
productSets.notes: 25-card Platinum insert checklist, numbered 1-25 and inserted 1:10 packs.
